title: Energy State Comparison
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state that the triplet state has the lower energy.

title: Explanation of Energy Difference
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the relationship between spin states and spatial wave functions, including the role of antisymmetry and electron repulsion.

title: Expression for Energy Separation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the energy separation between the singlet and triplet states.

title: Perturbation Hamiltonian
description: Important Criteria: The student should mention the perturbation Hamiltonian H' = e^2/r12 in their explanation.

title: Use of Wave Functions
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly reference the one-electron wave functions psi_{1s} and psi_{2s} in their expression for energy separation.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid incorrect signs in the expression for energy separation or in the comparison of energy states.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all necessary factors, such as the factor of 2 in the energy separation expression, are included.
